about: A verse whose draft the rules of meanings.py cannot bring to the style sheet: the whole meaning (as it is published), with its reason.

3.1.text: अर्जुनने कहा — हे जनार्दन! यदि आपके मतमें कर्मसे बुद्धि श्रेष्ठ है, तो हे केशव! मुझे इस घोर कर्ममें क्यों लगाते हैं?
3.1.why: Arjuna speaks to the Lord as आप and with honorific verbs, as everywhere else in the work (style.md §4); the draft has तुम here
